operations.description: Effects operations of the country: cyber attacks that aim at an effect outside the network.

targets.description: Targets that an attack aims at: one system, network or site, each with its own outcome.

targets/operation.description: Targets that one effects operation aims at.

targets/year.description: Targets in one 365-day year: targets hit, or assessed outcomes learned or lost.

person-years.description: The work of one expert for one 365-day year.

person-years/operation.description: Expert work for one effects operation.

person-years/target.description: Expert work for each target of an effects operation.

sev.description: Surveillance-equivalent value: the value that one expert gives the country in one year of surveillance in 2026. It is a unit of comparison between the two missions, not a price.

sev/person-year.description: Surveillance-equivalent value that one expert gives in one 365-day year.

sev/operation.description: Surveillance-equivalent value that one effects operation costs or gives.

sev/target.description: Surveillance-equivalent value of one intended effect on one target.

per_operation.description: A change for each effects operation.

years/operation.description: Years for each effects operation: the inverse of a rate of operations.

USD2025_m/person-year.description: Millions of US dollars at 2025 prices for the work of one expert for one 365-day year.

per_target.description: A change for each target or assessed outcome.

accesses.description: Accesses of surveillance: implants on computers and networks in other countries' networks.

accesses/year.description: Accesses of surveillance in one 365-day year: built, lost or taken by attacks.

person-years/access.description: Expert work to build one access of surveillance.

sev/access.description: Surveillance-equivalent value of one access of surveillance.

capabilities.description: Capabilities of the country: flaws that the defenders do not know, each with the tools that use it.

capabilities/year.description: Capabilities in one 365-day year: found, taken, burned or disclosed.

capabilities/operation.description: Capabilities that one effects operation needs at a step.

capabilities/access.description: New capabilities for each access that surveillance builds.

capabilities/person-year.description: Capabilities that one researcher finds in one 365-day year.

accesses/capability.description: Accesses of surveillance that run on one capability.

accesses/operation.description: Accesses of surveillance for each effects operation.

people/access.description: Analysts for each access whose collection they process.

capabilities/target.description: Capabilities that one target of an attack needs at a step: one for each kind of system of its attack.

access-years.description: Take of surveillance: what one implant collects in one 365-day year.
